title: hello
description: Client to host, the first message on a connection. The contract version is the envelope's `v`.

name.description: Display name of the person, shown to the others.

token.description: The session token from the host's add-on preferences. Required on the LAN port when it runs without TLS; ignored elsewhere. Case, spaces and dashes don't matter.

document.description: Optional: the document this client expects. If the host has another one open, it replies error wrong_document and closes.
